newsitem.title: POLAND: KB, PBR to launch funds April 21.
newsitem.headline: KB, PBR to launch funds April 21.

text.p: A mutual funds management firm, owned by Kleinwort Benson Group Plc and the Polish Development Bank (PBR), will launch three open-ended investment funds on April 21, the firm's president said on Friday.
"We will start the sale of participation units on April 21," Pawel Wojciechowski told a news conference.

Kleinwort Benson's subsidiary, Kleinwort Benson Investment Management Overseas BV and PBR have 50 percent each in the company, Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych Atut SA, which has a share capital of 10 million zlotys.
Wojciechowski said the first fund, Atut 1, would invest 50 percent in securities of fundamentally strong companies and the remainder in papers issued or guaranteed by the government.
The second, Atut 2, will invest only in treasuries. The third, Atut 3, will invest 50 percent in stocks of rapidly growing listed companies and the rest in the treasuries.
The initial price of the funds' participation unit is 10 zlotys and the first minimum investment 1,000 zlotys. Subsequent investments must amount to at least 100 zlotys.
The certificates would be distributed by brokerages of BPH, Kredyt Bank, PBR and PBK banks with no distribution fee.
Poland will have 13 open-ended investment funds after the launch of the three Atut funds.
